headline: Investigation - Competition Authority: no conclusion on price indexation by telecom operators
summary: The Competition Authority's investigation into mobile operators has not reached a conclusion on the practice of annual price indexation. The probe is ongoing.
why: Competition authorities review pricing practices in telecom markets, where regulatory outcomes can affect operator revenues and consumer tariffs.
